title: Oman seeks to mediate in Yemen as Houthis claim attack on Saudi tankers
gist: A 3m59s Al-Monitor 'Middle East Minute' episode page: the headline is Oman seeking to mediate in Yemen while the Houthis claim an attack on Saudi tankers, and the episode blurb adds two separate items -- the US and Saudi Arabia formally signing their nuclear power deal, and Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi making his first trip to Iran.

insights.claim: The United States and Saudi Arabia have officially signed their nuclear power deal, moving the agreement from negotiation to executed document.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: An executed US-Saudi civil nuclear agreement opens a multi-decade reactor, enrichment-policy and EPC opportunity set -- watch which US vendors and fuel-cycle terms are named.
insights.quote: The US and Saudi Arabia officially signed their nuclear power deal and Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made his first trip to Iran.

insights.claim: Riyadh secured a signed nuclear power agreement with Washington in the same news cycle as Houthi attacks on its tankers, showing Saudi long-horizon energy diversification is proceeding despite active attacks on its oil exports.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Saudi capex on non-oil energy is not conflict-contingent -- treat kingdom nuclear and power buildout as a structural theme rather than a peace dividend.

insights.claim: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made his first trip to Iran, using an early foreign visit to signal Baghdad's orientation toward Tehran.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: A new Iraqi premier's first destination is the cleanest available read on Baghdad's tilt -- it shapes Iraqi oil policy, sanctions leakage and US force posture.
insights.quote: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi made his first trip to Iran

insights.claim: Oman is seeking to mediate in Yemen, positioning Muscat as the diplomatic channel for the Yemen file in addition to its role on regional shipping issues.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Oman is the recurring broker across multiple simultaneous MENA conflicts -- Omani diplomatic activity is a leading indicator of de-escalation attempts.

insights.claim: The Houthis have claimed an attack on Saudi tankers, extending their targeting from general Red Sea shipping to the kingdom's own crude-carrying vessels.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Attacks on Saudi-flagged or Saudi-owned tankers specifically hit the export chain rather than third-party trade -- the escalation that actually moves crude.
insights.quote: Houthis claim attack on Saudi tankers
